description: South Korea tax on private pension withdrawals (pension savings, IRP: deducted contributions and earnings): withholding 5% under age 70, 4% to 79, 3% from 80 or for lifetime annuities (from 2026), plus 10% local tax. Over 15M a year, compares 15% separate tax with comprehensive taxation (pension deduction, other tax base). Public pensions and deferred severance in an IRP are not modeled.

annualPension.description: Private pension received this year (taxable part) (KRW)

lifetimeAnnuity.description: Paid under a lifetime annuity contract (3%); default false

otherTaxBase.description: Tax base from other comprehensive income, to compare comprehensive taxation when over 15M (KRW)
